title.justification: The title appears at the beginning of the paper.
title.value: A Generative Model of Symmetry Transformations

extractions.description: Empirical machine-learning paper introducing and evaluating a learned symmetry-aware generative model and VAE hybrids. The extraction below catalogs only its computational artifacts and compute configurations.

type.quote: We verify experimentally that our SGM correctly captures affine and color symmetries.
type.justification: The paper introduces a model and evaluates it experimentally on several image datasets.

name.quote: we take inspiration from group theoretic ideas to construct a generative model that explicitly aims to capture the data’s approximate symmetries
name.justification: The paper contributes a generative-modeling method for symmetry transformations.

name.quote: Learning symmetries in discriminative modeling is an active field of research
name.justification: The paper advances methods for learning symmetries, though in a generative rather than discriminative setting.

name.quote: Our model can be seen as a generative process for data augmentation.
name.justification: Learned, example-dependent data augmentation is an intended use and experimentally evaluated.

name.quote: We then learn an equivariant function fω via a self-supervised learning (SSL) scheme
name.justification: Self-supervised learning is used as a setting and training mechanism for the contributed model.
Digital pathology is used as an evaluation domain via PatchCamelyon, but the paper does not advance pathology itself.
Galaxy imagery is used as an evaluation domain, but astronomy itself is not advanced.
